description: Task-fit policy with relative cost and latency estimates, not a capability benchmark or measured prices. Filtered against native model/list. Default priority balanced; economy/speed/quality are explicit alternatives.

candidates.description: Modest agentic coding model at low effort: literal edits, command execution, recall and factual reporting. Prefer a higher effort for implementation requiring investigation.
Modest agentic coding model at medium effort: bounded repository implementation, ordinary debugging, tests and refactoring with tool use and verification.
Modest agentic coding model at high effort: harder bounded investigation and reasoning. Not the preferred capability for novel distributed-system architecture or repeated failed attempts.

Balanced agentic coding specialist for implementation across related modules, API contracts, integration tests and refactoring with several interacting requirements. Prefer this intermediate coding profile for substantial but well-scoped engineering, rather than treating all work as either a tiny fix or frontier research.

Balanced agentic coding specialist with deeper reasoning for difficult but bounded multi-module implementation and regression diagnosis. Frontier is reserved for unresolved cross-system architecture, novel reasoning or repeated unsuccessful approaches.

Frontier reasoning for difficult architecture, interacting concurrency invariants, cross-system failures after repeated attempts, and complex migration tradeoffs. Avoid paying this cost for ordinary work.
